about: Questions a photographer asks the assistant, each with the guide chapters its answer needs (src/assistantguide.ts). Every entry of expect must land in the material sent with the question; an entry that is a list is satisfied by any one of its chapters. The retrieval test (src/__tests__/assistantguide.test.ts) runs the set over the real guide.
